parsed.name: PV日志目录管理组件
parsed.description: 用于组织和管理过程变量（PV）日志目录结构的非物理软件组件，服务于实验数据归档与检索。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component that manages process-variable (PV) log folder structures for experiment data archiving and retrieval.

actions.description: 读取PVLogger日志文件夹，加载配置、日志文件列表及起止时间等信息。
actions.description_en: Read the PVLogger log folder and load configuration, log file list, and start/stop time information.

actions.description: 读取全部PV日志文件的文本内容。
actions.description_en: Read the text contents of all PV log files.

actions.description: 并行解析尚未处理的PV日志文件数据。
actions.description_en: Parse unprocessed PV log files in parallel.

actions.description: 重置并标记新发现的日志文件，可选择同时解析其数据。
actions.description_en: Reset and mark newly discovered log files, with optional data parsing.

actions.description: 按PV名称读取单个日志文件并记录文件时间戳。
actions.description_en: Read a single log file by PV name and record its file timestamp.

actions.description: 读取并整理电机相关PV的事件数据。
actions.description_en: Read and organize event data for motor-related PVs.

actions.description: 启动下一个日志解析子进程。
